problems: french-africa: no dossier exists yet (af-03-b / af-08). The dossiers of this batch carry the French takeovers as losses with counterpart french-africa (Waalo Feb 1855, Futa Toro 1859, Gajaaga 1858, Khasso 1880, Cayor Oct 1886, Baol 1894, Jolof 1890, Kaabu via Futa Jallon, Tukulor 1890-93, Wassoulou 1891-98, Kenedougou 1898, Kong 1897, Gwiriko Sept 1897, Damagaram July 1899, Bagirmi 1897, Rabih Aug 1901, Dar al-Kuti Dec 1912, Fuladu May 1903, Trarza Dec 1902, Brakna 1902, Bundu 1858, Saloum 1867); the matching gains belong in the french-africa ledger. It should also carry the protectorates: Samori 1887-1891, Tukulor 1887-1890, Futa Jallon 1896-1912, Dar al-Kuti 28 August 1897, Fuladu 1901 (French resident), Khasso September 1855, Bundu (undated).

songhai-empire has no Katsina events. The Katsina dossier of this batch records the Songhai occupation of 1512-1554 as occupation_start/occupation_end (counterpart songhai-empire, confidence 2, from the Katsina page); the songhai-empire owner should add the matching occupation or vassal events if the Songhai page supports them. The songhai-empire dissolves in 1599 with successor dendi-kingdom (the Dendi dossier of this batch starts in 1599; its war of 1592-94 lies outside its life, a validator warning left in place).

sokoto-caliphate: gains are dated 1805-1809 (Kebbi 1805/1808, Kano 1807, Zazzau and Zamfara 1809 as Cliopatria steps); the Kano, Katsina, Gobir, Kebbi, Zazzau and Zamfara dossiers of this batch use dates from their own pages (Kano 1805/1807, Katsina 1806, Gobir 3 October 1808, Kebbi 1808, Zazzau 1805, Zamfara 1809 bridging). Reconcile the Sokoto ledger.

empire-of-kanem (Bornu): the Bilala events (loss 1380, gain 1500, contest 1570-1603) are not reconciled with the Bilala page, which keeps Kanem under the Bilala until about 1630. Bornu should also carry the vassal periods of Bagirmi (from about 1571 until independence under Muhammad al-Amin), Damagaram (early), Kwararafa (end of the 18th century), Mandara (1614) and the Kano/Katsina tributes if its page supports them.
wadai-empire starts 1635 against 'around 1630' for the expulsion of the Bilala from Kanem (Bilala page); Dar al-Kuti was a Wadai tributary until 1890 (Dar al-Kuti page).

tukulor-empire: Bundu was taken over with the support of the Bundu aristocracy after 1851 (Bundu page) and Khasso's kings submitted in November 1854 (Khasso page): neither is in the Tukulor ledger. The Ségou fall is 10 March 1861 here against 10 March 1860 on the Umar Tall page; bamana-empire and massina-empire use 1861 and 1862 consistently with it.
kong-empire: no Gwiriko event. Gwiriko seized Tiefo, Dafin and Bwamu from Seku Watara's sons about 1740 (infobox: independence 1740); Kong's ledger should record the loss.
kaarta: the Kaarta dossier has Sira Bo vassalise Diarra in 1777 (Kaarta page); the Diarra page says 1754. Both are kept.

jolof-empire: the Jolof ledger has Sine and Saloum absorbed in the late 14th century and breaking away in 1520; the Saloum page says Saloum was never part of the empire and dates its foundation c. 1494, and the Sine dossier (c. 1335) has gain 1520 only. The 1390 events are bridging at confidence 1.
Sine is held to 1969 (end of the monarchy); the real loss of sovereignty is undated on every page opened, so the Sine shape overlaps the colonial dossiers for decades.
Fuladu: the page extends to northeastern Guinea-Bissau, which the kaabu dossier gives to Futa Jallon; the Fuladu shape is Kolda plus two Gambian regions.
validate_dossier warnings left: the Dendi war 1592-94 lies outside the state's life (1599-1901); a dossier-wide count after the last run is 1 warning in 41 dossiers.
